document_title: Tata Kryotec 2.0L Diesel & Revotron 1.2L Turbocharged Engine Service Manual
chapter: Chapter 3: Fuel Injection & Combustion Diagnostic Trouble Codes
section: Section 3.1: Cylinder Misfire Diagnostic Procedures (P0300 - P0304)
content:
FAULT CODE: P0300 - Random/Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected; P0301 - Cylinder 1 Misfire; P0303 - Cylinder 3 Misfire.
SYMPTOM: Check Engine Light flashing; unburned HC smell from exhaust tailpipe; noticeable rough idling and engine hesitation under acceleration (1500-2500 RPM).
PROBABLE CAUSES:
1. Faulty ignition pencil coil or degraded spark plug electrode gap (> 1.1 mm on Revotron 1.2L).
2. Piezo-electric or solenoid common-rail fuel injector clogging/leakage (Kryotec 2.0L).
3. Intake manifold vacuum leak or stuck PCV valve diaphragm.
4. Low compression in affected cylinder (less than 11.5 bar on Revotron or 24.0 bar on Kryotec).
DIAGNOSTIC WORKFLOW:
Step 1: Check freeze-frame data: record Fuel Trim (STFT, LTFT), Engine Coolant Temp (ECT), and Engine Load when DTC registered.
Step 2: On Petrol Revotron: inspect spark plug gap using wire gauge. Standard spec is 0.85 mm to 0.95 mm. Check pencil coil secondary winding resistance: 8.2 kOhm ± 0.8 kOhm.
Step 3: On Kryotec Diesel: Perform Common-Rail Injector Back-Leakage test across all 4 cylinders. Maximum permissible return flow is 25 ml per injector over 3 minutes of warm idle.
Step 4: Perform relative compression test using inductive current clamp on starter motor cable.
TORQUE SPECIFICATIONS: Spark plug torque: 22 Nm ± 2 Nm (apply anti-seize lightly). Pencil coil retention bolt M6: 9.0 Nm.

document_title: Tata Kryotec 2.0L Diesel & Revotron 1.2L Turbocharged Engine Service Manual
chapter: Chapter 3: Fuel Injection & Air Induction System
section: Section 3.4: Fuel System Lean Condition (P0171 Bank 1)
subsystem: Air Metering and Electronic Throttle Body
content:
FAULT CODE: P0171 - Fuel System Too Lean (Bank 1).
CRITERIA: Long Term Fuel Trim (LTFT) exceeds +22% for longer than 8 seconds under closed-loop fueling condition.
SYMPTOM: Poor throttle response, surging at cruising speed, potential pinging/detonation during uphill acceleration.
DIAGNOSTIC WORKFLOW:
Step 1: Inspect Mass Air Flow (MAF) / Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) sensor reading at idle: At 800 RPM warm idle, MAF should read 2.2 g/s to 2.8 g/s. If < 1.8 g/s, clean MAF hot wire using approved solvent.
Step 2: Smoke test intake air ducting from air cleaner box to turbocharger compressor inlet and intercooler piping for unmetered air leaks.
Step 3: Test upstream Oxygen Sensor (Lambda / Wideband O2). Pin 3 heater circuit resistance should be 3.5 to 5.0 Ohms at room temperature (20°C). Sensor signal should oscillate dynamically between 0.1V and 0.9V.
Step 4: Verify fuel rail pressure. At idle, Revotron GDI fuel pressure should be 40 to 50 bar; Kryotec common rail should be 300 to 350 bar.

document_title: Tata Kryotec 2.0L Diesel & Revotron 1.2L Turbocharged Engine Service Manual
chapter: Chapter 4: Turbocharger & Variable Geometry Turbine (VGT) System
content:
FAULT CODE: P0299 - Turbocharger/Supercharger 'A' Underboost Condition.
CRITERIA: Manifold boost pressure falls more than 35 kPa (5.1 psi) below target boost command for 5 consecutive seconds under wide-open throttle.
SYMPTOM: Severe power loss above 2200 RPM, black smoke on diesel acceleration, whistling noise from engine compartment.
DIAGNOSTIC WORKFLOW:
Step 1: Check electronic VGT vacuum actuator solenoid valve resistance across pins 1 and 2: Expected value is 14.5 Ohm ± 1.0 Ohm.
Step 2: Apply 500 mmHg vacuum directly to the VGT turbo actuator using hand pump. Verify actuator pushrod travels smoothly 11.5 mm to 13.0 mm without binding.
Step 3: Inspect intercooler plastic end-tanks and silicone boost hoses for splits or loose constant-tension hose clamps.
Step 4: Check Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) valve position. If EGR valve is stuck open by carbon accumulation, exhaust gases bypass the turbine wheel.
TORQUE SPECIFICATION: Turbocharger exhaust manifold flange nuts (high-temperature copper-plated M8): 32 Nm ± 3 Nm.

document_title: Tata Kryotec 2.0L Diesel & Revotron 1.2L Turbocharged Engine Service Manual
section: Section 5.2: Catalyst System Efficiency Threshold (P0420 / SCR De-NOx)
content:
FAULT CODE: P0420 - Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1); DTC P20EE - SCR NOx Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold.
CRITERIA: Ratio of switch count between downstream post-cat O2 sensor and upstream pre-cat O2 sensor exceeds 0.75.
DIAGNOSTIC WORKFLOW:
Step 1: Check for exhaust system leaks upstream of catalytic converter or DPF flange. Even pinhole leaks introduce ambient oxygen, skewing sensor signals.
Step 2: Inspect downstream Heated Oxygen Sensor (HO2S). Under steady 2000 RPM cruising load, downstream sensor signal must remain flat and stable at 0.55V to 0.70V.
Step 3: Measure temperature differential across catalytic converter using an infrared pyrometer: Converter outlet temperature must be at least 30°C to 50°C higher than inlet temperature when operating efficiently.
Step 4: On Diesel SCR models, test DEF (Diesel Exhaust Fluid / AdBlue) concentration using an optical refractometer: Urea concentration must measure 32.5% ± 0.7%.
